Malformed storage/read/write/remove errors fail safely without issuing a fresh mutation key

External contact destinations explicit; footer wrapping/focus/minimum tap-size styles present

Favicon SVG uses existing construction mark; local raster generation uses existing sharp dependency

limitations: Robolectric and Gradle final artifacts were not independently rerun by this reviewer; author is refreshing evidence after final strict-type /me change

Browser screenshots/keyboard/mobile visual execution NOT_RUN because browser engines unavailable
